sentences.en: Averages come in three flavors: mean, median, and mode.
sentences.zh: 平均值有三种类型：均值、中位数和众数。

sentences.en: At present I am working for a median university.
sentences.zh: 目前我在一所中等水平的大学工作。

sentences.en: It is important to know the difference between mean and median.
sentences.zh: 区分均值和中位数是很重要的。
